propositions: When file_impact is undeclared, SHA drift currently invalidates on any code change, causing 21% of reviews to re-run on unchanged material; scoping to the read-set and blast-radius paths reduces false positives.

The read-set is normalized from distinct_fetches by filtering to read_file operations, resolving paths relative to the repo root, dropping non-existent and out-of-scope files, and deduplicating in POSIX form.
The signed manifest records normalized read paths plus a membership digest for glob-pattern blast-radius entries, such that tampered or modified read-sets fail verification and trigger invalidation.

Re-validation composes read-set with blast-radius entries only when four preconditions hold: the declared impact is empty, the ticket is not poisoned, scope is undeclared, and a read-set was recorded.
The currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) is recorded in the signed manifest and reported by plan_review_status and review-plan --status.
Unverifiable read-sets, pre-change attestations lacking the field, and expansion failures fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation on any change.
